projects.name: Vadhvan port area land values and compensation benchmarks
projects.description: Official per-hectare compensation rates, as reported, for the roughly 606 ha of land being acquired in 24 Palghar and Dahanu villages for Vadhvan port road and rail links. Officials link the higher rates to revised circle rates and more land transactions in recent years.

events.title: Compensation above Rs 2 crore/ha approved for agricultural land for Vadhvan port project
events.description: Owners get double the fixed market value plus 100% solatium, with 12% interest from 29 Aug 2024. Palghar taluka base rate is Rs 62.50 lakh/ha. Dahanu villages such as Varor and Bawde have base rates of Rs 1.16–1.22 crore/ha, reaching up to Rs 4.88 crore/ha.
events.quote: Palghar district authorities have approved compensation exceeding ₹2 crore per hectare for agricultural land acquired for the Vadhvan Port Project in Maharashtra.

events.title: Land bill for Vadhvan connectivity rises to ~Rs 2,300 crore vs Rs 800 crore estimate
events.description: Officials give these reasons: revised Palghar circle rates, higher benchmark values from more land transactions, project delay, and demand driven by port expectations. The original estimate used a circle rate of about Rs 24 lakh/ha. About 60% of the land is valued at Rs 62.5 lakh/ha and 40% (six coastal villages) at Rs 2.20 crore/ha.
events.quote: Higher benchmark values due to increased land transactions in recent years.

land.purpose: Road and rail connectivity for Vadhvan Port
